migrated_capabilities.scope: Reimplemented application entry point, namespaced settings, health and readiness checks, and HTTP error envelopes. The API does not initialize external dependencies.
Adapted declared and streamed request body limits, password validation, and public error redaction.
Adapted credential storage and authentication. Added generic role checks and audit records with sanitized context. Tests use in-memory SQLite.
Adapted path and extension rules, TXT/PDF/DOCX parsing, task transitions, and a synchronous parsing adapter. No queue, upload HTTP endpoint, or automatic indexing.

Adapted in-memory ranking, deterministic snapshot metadata, and Hit@k calculation. The vector and rerank adapters take injected functions; verification uses sample data rather than model weights or industrial evaluation cases.
Reimplemented request state, event correlation and safe failure handling in a Python standard-library scaffold. No LangGraph integration or domain-specific execution.
Built an IndustrialOps home page and adapted error and token handling for its API client. The page links to the API health endpoint.
Built independent package metadata and API-only container configuration. The build context excludes local evidence, credentials, and downloaded assets.

notes: Source paths identify the source patterns consulted at the fixed baseline, including capabilities reimplemented for IndustrialOps.
Excluded source capabilities also include the domain agents and debate engine, domain UI and tests, multimodal and audio pipelines, and domain retrieval benchmarks.
The v0.1 scope omits HTTP login and upload routes, distributed rate and concurrency limits, Redis queue workers, MySQL migrations, persistent vector storage and equipment-pack ingestion.
The phase 0 freeze and local evidence are outside this migration and are excluded from the container build context.

The Python and frontend suites, frontend build, legacy reference scan, installed-wheel startup and Compose configuration validation passed. Fresh dependency fetching and container startup remain unverified in the current environment.
